description:
A captured integer, float, pid or reference read as a ref word points at the frame's own slot, so the pop must skip that frame. Distiller: 3.3% of frames pinned (32k trace 2,480,050 of 74,267,467; full 3.5%). Carry such captures raw so the frame does not pin. Acceptance: pinned count near zero on the distiller, telemetry pin.
Proposal (approved 2026-11-14): https://claude.ai/artifact/94aN2YPxunzwVEzct26nz2 (local /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-d7w.html). Spike evidence: worktree ../fz-hc, branch exp/heap-cont-reads (uncommitted, FZ_SPIKE_* switches).
title: A captured scalar stays raw in its frame
